verdict.rationale: Mistral publishes a developer quickstart titled "Send your first API request" and self-serve Organization usage and limits dashboards, and one community user describes opening an account, getting billed, and deleting it. Together these imply a self-serve onboarding path, but no cited text describes signing up or creating an API key. Missing for 10: explicit docs on account signup and API key creation, evidence that no waitlist or sales contact is needed, and hands-on corroboration of the key-minting flow.
